description.value: Permanently sense every active machine intelligence and ghost-machine within a wide radius.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'electromagnetic-sense' is a real, confirmed sense type (pf2e-source SENSE_TYPES) that matches sensing machine intelligences, but it is not in SENSES_WITH_UNLIMITED_RANGE, so a finite range is required and 'a wide radius' states no foot value. The card states a bonus/effect but gives no numeric value or formula to build a rule element from without inventing one.
